label: knee_flexion_left_full
name: Knee flexion (left)
prompt: The patient smoothly bends the left knee, bringing the heel back toward the buttock, through the full normal range, comfortably, face relaxed. Holds the end position for two seconds. Then slowly returns to the exact starting pose. The last frame must match the first frame exactly. Mouth closed and relaxed, no speaking. About 10 seconds long (at least 10 seconds), 25 fps, with the movement paced slowly to fill the time.
